description:
This file contains function prototypes for the Content Filtering Reporting Message Management Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.
It acts as an interface declaration for external modules to interact with the CF RMMO component.

methods.name: CfRmmoComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a component instance of the Content Filtering Reporting Message Management Object.

methods.name: CfRmmoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the RMMO.

methods.name: CfRmmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for RMMO operation.
